name: Submarine Kss3
designation: KSS-III Dosan Ahn Changho-class diesel-electric attack submarine
axis_orientation: bow (sonar dome) is at +1, stern (propulsor/planes) is at -1
operating_principle: The KSS-III Dosan Ahn Changho-class submarine operates using diesel-electric propulsion, with an advanced air-independent propulsion system allowing extended submerged endurance without snorkeling. It achieves submerged speeds of around 20 knots and has an operational range exceeding 10,000 nautical miles when surfaced.

components.description: The primary structural body of the submarine, providing a strong and watertight compartment for the crew and equipment.
The sail or fin of the submarine, housing the command and control systems, as well as communication equipment.
The diesel-electric propulsion system, including the diesel engines, electric motors, and air-independent propulsion system.
components.material_dependency: High strength steel and advanced electronics

components.description: The VLS is a missile launching system capable of firing submarine-launched ballistic missiles and other munitions.
The compartment housing the torpedo tubes and associated equipment.
The command center of the submarine, housing the crew and equipment necessary for controlling the vessel.
The compartments housing the air-independent propulsion system, batteries, and other machinery necessary for the submarine's operation.
components.material_dependency: High strength steel and advanced electronics

components.description: The bow-mounted sonar dome, providing a critical sensor system for the submarine.
